d.ko:
"Romance of the Three Kingdoms 11 with Power Up Kit" is an expanded version of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms 11," which was released in 2006 as the 11th game in the series.
The grand battles that shaped the course of Chinese history are shown in 3D space!
In Administration, players freely develop cities. In Battle, players experience intellectual battles using strategies and traps. Duels have evolved into quick paced challenges shown in impressive 3D. In addition, the Power Up Kit adds new scenarios and events, a "Final Battle mode," the "Absorb/Merge system," the "Research skills system," and an "Officer/Base editor."

d.zh: 以3D空间的水墨画风格为背景的中国大陆为舞台，在「内政」中实现自由的城市开发，在「战斗」中运用战法和陷阱进行战斗。此外，威力加强版还将增加「新剧本·事件」、「决战称霸模式」、「吸收合并系统」、「研究能力系统」以及各种编辑功能等内容。

한글 패치해야 하는 불편함이 있지만 여러가지 시스템을 잘 반영해놓음. 군주제 중에 복잡한 축에 들어가고 시스템 적응에 시간이 걸림. 심플한 옛날 군주제(4,5 등) 생각하고 하면 할 일이 많고 시간이 오래 걸려서 질릴 수 있음. …
Easily the best of the Romance series. I like the way it's set up, the graphic is simplistic yet it makes the game really fun to play. …
Classic. Up there with the Age of Empires II as a great strategy game. Love the history too.
Normal games becomes super easy once you understand how to exploit tricks. The challenges are carefully designed though.
每次打开这个游戏，大学时代的美好回忆就会一一浮现，为当时玩的盗版游戏补个票，顺便感叹下光荣可能再也做不出比这款更经典的三国了。
如果说，每年都会有那么几个游戏想来上一把，SAN11算一个。
